for. Risks link to a team, not an objective, so these are the risks the team carries.

Everything needed to recommend a health check for one planning interval objective, gathered in

from 0 (not started) to 1 (target reached or passed).

Why the version is being reverted. Required — this contradicts what the status history already
asserts, so the record has to say why.

RevertVersionReleaseRequest.description: Records that a version marked as shipped did not in fact ship.

order.description: The order of the Roadmap Activity within its parent.
The order of the Roadmap Activity within its parent.

color.description: The color, as a hex code (e.g. "#4096FF").

name.description: The caption describing what the color represents on this Roadmap.

order.description: The order of the color within the Roadmap's configured colors.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default color applied to activities that have no color of their own.

id.description: The roadmap's unique identifier.

key.description: The roadmap's numeric key, an alternate to its id.

name.description: The name of the Roadmap.

description.description: The description of the Roadmap.

visibility.description: The visibility of the Roadmap. If the Roadmap is public, all users can see the Roadmap. Otherwise, only the Roadmap Managers can see the Roadmap.

colors.description: The colors configured on the Roadmap, ordered by their configured order.

id.description: The roadmap item Id.

name.description: The name of the roadmap item.

description.description: The description of the roadmap item.

color.description: The color of the roadmap item. Must be a valid hex color code.

name.description: The name of the roadmap item.

color.description: The color of the roadmap item. Must be a valid hex color code.

id.description: The roadmap's unique identifier.

key.description: The roadmap's numeric key, an alternate to its id.

name.description: The name of the Roadmap.

visibility.description: The visibility of the Roadmap. If the Roadmap is public, all users can see the Roadmap. Otherwise, only the Roadmap Managers can see the Roadmap.

color.description: The color of the Roadmap. Must be a valid hex color code.

reason.description: Why it was reverted.

rolledBackAt.description: When it was reverted. Defaults to now, and cannot be before the deployment completed.

RollBackDeploymentRequest.description: Records that a deployment reached its environment and was then reverted.

deploymentId.description: The deployment this was read from, so a caller can open the record behind the answer.

version.description: The version record, where one is recorded in Wayd.

versionLabel.description: The version as it should be read, whether or not a version record backs it. Free text.

package.description: The package that carried it, where it arrived inside one rather than on its own.

artifactId.description: The build that actually shipped, where one was recorded. Free text, never parsed.

hasFailedAttemptSince.description: Whether a later deployment touching this product failed or was rolled back here.

RolloutItemDto.description: One product currently live in an environment, and the deployment that put it there.

name.description: The name of the scale (e.g., "Fibonacci", "Impact").

levels.description: The ordered rating levels of the scale.

label.description: The label for the rating level (e.g., "Very High").

value.description: The numeric value a chosen rating contributes.

defaultWorkingDays.description: The days of the week new team operating models work, Monday first.

defaultHolidayCalendar.description:
The holiday calendar of every team operating model that has none of its own, or null for none. Carries its
name, so someone who may view the settings but not list the calendars still sees which it is.

workingDayHours.description: How many hours a working day has, which time away entered in hours is a share of.

scoredBy.description: The employee who recorded the score. May be null if the scorer is not found.

ScoreSummaryDto.description:
A summary of a project's current score: the score, when it was recorded, who recorded it, and the
scoring model used.

name.description: The name of the criterion.

token.description: The token used to reference this criterion in output formulas (e.g., "BV").

description.description: An optional description of the criterion.

weight.description: An optional, non-authoritative weight (used only by the weighted-formula scaffolder).

scaleId.description: The optional rating scale this criterion is rated against. Null = free numeric entry.

ScoringModelEvaluationDto.description:
The result of evaluating a scoring model against a set of supplied criterion values. Carries every
output value (in evaluation order) plus the primary score, so callers can preview formula results.

name.description: The name of the output (e.g., "Cost of Delay", "WSJF").

token.description: The token other output formulas can reference (e.g., "CoD").

formula.description: The arithmetic formula over criterion and earlier-output tokens.

isPrimary.description: Whether this output is the model's primary score.

ScoringModelOutputValueDto.description: A single named output value produced by an evaluation.

label.description: The label for the rating level (e.g., "Very High").

value.description: The numeric value a chosen rating contributes to the criterion.

name.description: The name of the scale (e.g., "Fibonacci", "Impact").

id.description: The unique identifier of the environment.

isActive.description: Whether this environment can still be deployed into.

SetDeploymentEnvironmentActiveRequest.description: Takes an environment out of use, or puts it back. Deployments already recorded against it stand.

externalViewWorkItemUrlTemplate.description: The URL prefix a work item's external id is appended to; null, empty or whitespace clears it.

SetExternalUrlTemplatesRequest.description: Sets or clears a Managed workspace's external view work item URL template.

personaIds.description: Every persona tagged on the goal. A list rather than a read-only one so a JSON Patch can append to it.

isActive.description:
True to put the tag back into use, false to take it out of use. Requests already carrying it keep it
either way.

SetIntakeRequestTagActiveRequest.description: Whether requests can be given a tag.

isActive.description:
True to put the axis back into use, false to take it out of use. Requests already tagged along it keep
their tags either way.

SetIntakeRequestTagCategoryActiveRequest.description: Whether requests can be tagged along a tag axis.

isActive.description: Whether products can still be tagged with this.

SetProductTagActiveRequest.description: Retires a tag from new use, or puts it back. Products already carrying it keep it.

id.description: The unique identifier of the tag category.

isActive.description: Whether products can still be tagged along this axis.

SetProductTagCategoryActiveRequest.description: Takes a tag axis out of use, or puts it back. Products already tagged keep their tags.

id.description: The unique identifier of the product type.

isActive.description: Whether new products can be created with this type.

SetProductTypeActiveRequest.description: Takes a product type out of use, or puts it back.

versionIds.description: The versions this release carries directly, outside any package.

SetReleaseContentsRequest.description:
Replaces everything a release announces — the packages it shipped and the versions it carries
directly.

components.description: Every component version in this package. Replaces the manifest entirely.

teamDaysOff.description:
The days within the sprint's planned dates that the whole team is off for some or all of, such as an
offsite, each listed once. An empty list clears them. Holidays from the team's calendar and days outside
its working week need not be listed.

SetSprintTeamDaysOffRequest.description: Replaces a sprint's team days off.

sprintType.description:
The sprint's type, held whatever its planning interval mapping says. Null clears the team's type, so the
sprint follows the category of the planning interval iteration it is mapped to, or is standard when it
is not mapped.

SetSprintTypeRequest.description: Sets or clears the type the team set on a sprint.

personaIds.description: Every persona tagged on the step. A list rather than a read-only one so a JSON Patch can append to it.
Every persona tagged on the task. A list rather than a read-only one so a JSON Patch can append to it.

startDate.description: The start date for this operating model.

timeZone.description: The IANA id of the time zone the team of teams' own rollups count days in.

startDate.description: The start date for this operating model.

methodology.description: The methodology the team uses (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).

sizingMethod.description: The sizing method the team uses (e.g., StoryPoints, Count).

timeZone.description: The IANA id of the time zone the team's days are counted in.

commitmentGraceDays.description: Days after a sprint's planned start that its commitment is taken when the team does not start it.

workingDays.description: The days of the week the team works. At least one. Omit to carry over the current model's working week.

holidayCalendarId.description: The holiday calendar whose holidays the team takes off, or null for the system default calendar.

cadenceWeeks.description:
The length in weeks of a Kanban team's reporting periods, used for its velocity trend, or null for no cadence.
A Scrum team's sprints are its cadence, so a Scrum model takes none.

cadenceAnchor.description:
The first day of one of the cadence's periods, which aligns the others. Required with
int? SetTeamOperatingModelRequest.CadenceWeeks, and omitted without it.

mode.description: `AnyToAny` to allow every move, or `Restricted` to allow only the workflow's transitions.

SetWorkflowTransitionModeRequest.description: A request to let a draft workflow's records move between any statuses, or only along its transitions.

transitions.description: Every move the workflow should allow. Moves not listed are removed; an empty list removes them all.

SetWorkflowTransitionsRequest.description: A request to replace the moves a draft workflow allows, and the conditions on each.

SortDirection.description: Which way a list runs along its sort key.

started.description: When the team actually started the sprint. Omit to follow the planned start.

completed.description: When the team actually completed the sprint. Omit to follow the planned end.

SprintActualDatesRequest.description: A sprint's corrected actual dates. Both values are replaced; omit one to revert it to the sprint's default.

effort.description: The level-of-effort estimate, Scrum's backlog item estimate; null when unestimated.

size.description: The size estimate, the CMMI process's requirement estimate; null when unestimated.

sprintId.description: The sprint the burn is of.

sizingMethod.description:
The estimate the burn is measured in: its team's sizing method on the sprint's planned start, or Count
for a sprint with no team.

effectiveStart.description: The commitment point, where the burn and its ideal line start.

effectiveEnd.description: The effective end, where the ideal line reaches zero.

timeZone.description: The IANA zone the sprint's days are counted in.

historyIncomplete.description:
Whether a workspace holding the sprint's work has not had its history read through to the end, so the
burn may be missing changes.

committed.description: The work committed at the commitment point, where the ideal burn-down line starts.

points.description: The readings, in time order; empty before the commitment point.

ideal.description:
The ideal burn-down over the whole sprint, however much has passed: points at the commitment point, the
start of each day in the team's zone, and the effective end, joined by straight lines. It falls only on
the days the team works — its working week, less holidays and team days off — and stays flat on the rest.

SprintBurnDto.description:
A sprint's burn-up and burn-down, worked out from work item history: its scope and completed work at the
commitment point, at the end of each of its days in the team's zone, and at the effective end — or now, for
a sprint that has not ended. Counts and estimates both, so a viewer can switch unit without refetching.

day.description: The team's calendar day the reading closes.

scope.description: The work in scope at the reading.

completed.description: The part of the scope in a Done- or Removed-category status at the reading.

SprintBurnPointDto.description: One reading of a sprint's burn.

start.description: The first planned day of the sprint, which the capacity is counted from.

end.description: The last planned day of the sprint, which the capacity is counted to.

allocatedPersonDays.description: The time allocated to the team over the sprint's planned dates in every role, in person-days, after holidays and time away.

deliveryPersonDays.description: The part of it in roles that count toward delivery capacity, in person-days. What the scope is set against.

awayPersonDays.description: The allocated time that people's time away takes, in person-days; already left out of the other two.

hasAllocations.description:
Whether anyone is allocated to the team on any of the sprint's planned dates, whatever holidays, time away
and team days off leave of it. False is a team that does not plan capacity, rather than one whose people
are all away.

sizingMethod.description: The estimate `scope` and `expectedScope` are in: the sprint's sizing method.

scopeBasis.description: Which scope is set against the capacity: the work planned so far before the commitment point, the committed work after it.

scope.description: The scope, by count under Count and otherwise in `sizingMethod`. An item with no estimate adds nothing.

outcome.description: Whether the scope could be compared with what the capacity is expected to deliver, and if not, why.

expectedScope.description:
What the capacity is expected to deliver, in the scope's unit: the team's velocity per person-day of
delivery capacity over its recent completed sprints, times this sprint's. Null unless compared.

priorSprints.description: How many completed sprints `expectedScope` was drawn from.

isOverCapacity.description: Whether the scope is more than `expectedScope`. Never true for a completed sprint.

SprintCapacityDto.description:
A sprint's capacity over its planned dates, in person-days, beside its scope and what that capacity is
expected to deliver. Worked out when read from the team's allocations and recent sprints; never stored.

key.description: The sprint's unique key, an alternate to its `id`. Endpoints differ in which of the two they accept; a uuid parameter takes the id.

name.description: The name of the sprint.

state.description: The sprint's state now, worked out from its actual and default dates when read.

start.description: The first planned day of the sprint.

end.description: The last planned day of the sprint, included in it.

teamIsActive.description:
Whether the sprint's team is active. An inactive team's allocations can no longer be added to, so its
capacity plan is read-only.

started.description: When the team started the sprint, if it did.

completed.description: When the team completed the sprint, if it did.

activeFrom.description:
When the sprint became Active: `started`, or by default the start of its first planned day
in `timeZone`, never before the previous sprint ended. `state` is Future before
it. Null for a sprint whose team is not mapped or that has no planned dates.

activeUntil.description:
When the sprint stops being Active, exclusive: `completed`, or by default the end of its last
planned day, cut to the next sprint's start where the two overlap. A sprint that runs to the end of a day
ends at the next midnight, so its last day is the one before.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone the sprint's planned days are counted in: its team's on the planned start.

teamDaysOff.description:
Days within the sprint the whole team is off for some or all of beyond its working week and holiday
calendar, such as an offsite, in date order. Those managing the sprint (`canManageSprint`) can change
them.

workingDayHours.description:
How many hours a working day has, the system's scheduling setting: a team day off entered in hours is a
share of it.

holidays.description:
The holidays in the team's calendar during the sprint's planned dates, or the system default calendar's when
the team names none: days the team is already off, so never a team day off. Empty without a team or dates.

workingDays.description:
The days of the week the team works during the sprint, from its operating model on the sprint's planned
start. Empty without a team or dates.

sprintType.description:
Whether the sprint is comparable with the team's other sprints. A non-standard sprint is left out of
the team's sprint metrics. Worked out when read: see `sprintTypeSource`.

sprintTypeSource.description:
Where `sprintType` came from: the team, the mapped planning interval iteration's category,
or the default. Those managing the sprint (`canManageSprint`) can set or clear the team's.

overlapsPreviousSprint.description: Whether the source system plans this sprint to overlap the team's previous sprint.

overlapsNextSprint.description: Whether the source system plans this sprint to overlap the team's next sprint.

canManageSprint.description:
Whether the caller may start, complete or reopen the sprint: a member of its team or team of teams
holding the permission, or an administrator.

canStart.description: Whether the sprint's lifecycle allows starting it now, whoever asks.

startWindow.description: The moments the sprint can be recorded as started, now or earlier. Null when it can't be started.

canComplete.description: Whether the sprint's lifecycle allows completing it now, whoever asks.

completeWindow.description: The moments the sprint can be recorded as completed, now or earlier. Null when it can't be completed.

canReopen.description: Whether the sprint's lifecycle allows reopening it now, whoever asks.

openSprint.description: Another sprint of the team that is still open, which starting this one completes.

remaining.description:
The share of the committed work still expected to remain: 1 at the commitment point, 0 at the effective
end. Multiply by the committed work in either unit.

SprintIdealPointDto.description: A point on a sprint's ideal burn-down.

key.description: The sprint's unique key, an alternate to its `id`. Endpoints differ in which of the two they accept; a uuid parameter takes the id.

name.description: The name of the sprint.

state.description: The sprint's state now, worked out from its actual and default dates when read.

start.description: The first planned day of the sprint.

end.description: The last planned day of the sprint, included in it.

started.description: When the team started the sprint, if it did.

completed.description: When the team completed the sprint, if it did.

sprintType.description:
Whether the sprint is comparable with the team's other sprints. A non-standard sprint is left out of
the team's sprint metrics. Worked out when read: see `sprintTypeSource`.

sprintTypeSource.description:
Where `sprintType` came from: the team, the mapped planning interval iteration's category,
or the default.

velocity.description: What was completed while in the sprint, including work completed as Removed.

predictability.description: Velocity ÷ committed, up to 1; null when there is no commitment in this unit.

sayDo.description: Completed of committed ÷ committed; null when there is no commitment in this unit.

SprintMetricFiguresDto.description: A sprint's velocity, predictability and say/do in one unit.

sprintWindow.description:
How many of a team's most recent completed standard sprints its velocity, predictability and say/do
are averaged over.

activeFrom.description:
When the sprint became Active: when the team started it, or else the start of its first planned day in
`TimeZone`. Null for a sprint whose team is not mapped.

activeUntil.description:
When the sprint stops being Active, exclusive: a sprint that runs to the end of a day ends at the next
midnight, so its last day is the one before.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone the sprint's days are counted in: its team's.

sizingMethod.description:
The estimate the sprint is measured in: its team's sizing method on the sprint's planned start. Under
Count every estimate equals its item count.

unestimatedWorkItems.description: Items with no value in `SizingMethod`. An estimate of 0 is an estimate.

SprintMetricsSummary.description: Metrics summary for an individual sprint within the PI Iteration.

SprintMetricSummariesDto.description: Each metric summarized across the sprints that have a value for it; null when none has.

average.description: The mean of the sprints' values, not a ratio of their pooled totals.

standardDeviation.description: The population standard deviation of the sprints' values.

sprints.description: How many sprints had a value for this metric.

SprintMetricSummaryDto.description: One metric across a team's sprints.

sprintId.description: The sprint the scope is of.

sizingMethod.description:
The estimate the report is measured in: its team's sizing method on the sprint's planned start, or
Count for a sprint with no team. Under Count every estimate equals its item count.

effectiveStart.description: The commitment point: what was in the sprint here is committed.

startIsActual.description: Whether the effective start is the team's recorded start rather than the default.

effectiveEnd.description: The effective end: what is in the sprint here is completed or carried over.

endIsActual.description: Whether the effective end is the team's recorded completion rather than the default.

lastDay.description:
The start of the sprint's last day. Unfinished work moved to the team's next sprint from here on is
carried over; before it, descoped.

timeZone.description: The IANA zone the sprint's days are counted in.

hasTeam.description:
Whether the sprint has a team. A sprint with none is counted in the system default zone and grace
period, by item count.

historyIncomplete.description:
Whether the history of a workspace holding the sprint's work has not yet been read through to the end.
The figures are then unreliable, and a full sync completes them.

ideal.description:
The ideal burn-down from the commitment point to the effective end, which the sprint's health measures
progress against: falling only on the days the team works. The same line as the sprint burn's.

items.description: Each requirement-tier work item that was in the sprint's scope, in backlog order.

SprintScopeDto.description:
What a sprint committed to and what became of it, worked out from work item history between the sprint's
effective start and end. Only requirement-tier work counts. A sprint that has not ended is measured up to
now, and one that has not reached its commitment point has no scope yet.

workItem.description: The work item as it is now; its current sprint may be another one.

entry.description: Whether the item was committed or added.

outcome.description: What became of the item: completed, completed as Removed, carried over, descoped or remaining.

addedAt.description: When an added item was added to the sprint; null for a committed one.

removedAt.description:
When the item was last removed from the sprint — moved to another iteration or out of the requirement
tier; not when it reached a Removed status. Null if it was still in at the effective end, or is still
in a sprint that has not ended.

entryEstimate.description: The item's estimate when it was committed or added.

outcomeEstimate.description: The item's estimate when it was last in the sprint.

SprintScopeItemDto.description: A work item that was in the sprint's scope, as it is now, with how it came in and what became of it.

estimate.description: The sum of their estimates in the report's sizing method.

SprintScopeMeasureDto.description: How many items, and how much estimate, fall in one category. A missing estimate adds nothing.

total.description:
Every item that was in scope, measured like the outcomes: the sum of Completed, Carried Over, Descoped
and Remaining. By count it also equals Committed plus Added; by estimate it need not, since an item
re-estimated during the sprint comes in at one estimate and leaves at another.

committed.description: Items in the sprint at its commitment point, at their estimate then.

added.description: Items that entered the sprint after its commitment point, at their estimate when added.

completed.description: Completed items, including those completed as Removed.

removed.description: The part of `completed` completed as Removed.

carriedOver.description:
Unfinished items still in the sprint at its effective end, or moved to the team's next sprint on or
after its last day.

descoped.description:
Unfinished items taken out of the sprint before its last day, or on it for somewhere other than the
team's next sprint.

remaining.description: Unfinished work still in a sprint that has not ended.

completedOfCommitted.description:
Committed items that were completed, measured with their committed estimate so it compares with
`committed`.

sayDoCount.description: Completed of committed ÷ committed, by item count; null when nothing was committed.

sayDoEstimate.description: Completed of committed ÷ committed, by estimate; null when the committed work had no estimate.

predictabilityCount.description:
Completed ÷ committed by item count, up to 1: how much of what the team committed to it delivered,
letting finished added work stand in for committed work. Null when nothing was committed.

predictabilityEstimate.description: Completed ÷ committed by estimate, up to 1; null when the committed work had no estimate.

unestimated.description: Items with no value in the sprint's estimate when they were last in the sprint.

SprintScopeTotalsDto.description:
A sprint's scope summed by category. Committed and Added are measured with the estimate each item had when
it came in; the outcomes with the estimate it had when it was last in the sprint.

date.description: The day, within the sprint's planned dates.

percentOff.description:
The share of the working day the team is off, from 1 to 100; 100, a full day, when left out. A half-day
offsite is 50: it takes half of everyone's capacity that day, and the ideal burn-down drops by half a day.

SprintTeamDayOffRequest.description: A day the whole team is off for some or all of.

SprintTypeDto.description: A sprint type, with the code a sprint carries and the request to set one accepts.

sizingMethod.description:
The estimate the sprint is measured in: its team's sizing method on the sprint's planned start, or
Count for a sprint with no team. Under Count every estimate equals its item count.

totalEstimate.description: The sum of every item's estimate in `sizingMethod`; unestimated items add nothing.

unestimatedWorkItems.description: Items with no value in `sizingMethod`. An estimate of 0 is an estimate.

cycleTime.description:
Cycle-time rollup for the sprint. Carries count and total so callers can
aggregate across sprints without average-of-averages bias.

SprintWorkItemMetricsDto.description:
Work item metrics for a single sprint, as item counts and as estimates in the sprint's sizing method. Only
requirement-tier work counts: tasks are left out, and bugs count only where the process puts them at the
requirement level.

StageBulkTenantMigrationRequest.description:
Bulk tenant migration payload. The provider id comes from the route; this body
carries the source/target tenants and the selected users.

name.description: The name of the stage.

description.description: The description of the stage.

tenantId.description: The tenant the user signs in from. Optional when the Entra provider allows a single tenant.

versionId.description: The version deployed, when this deployment carries a single artifact.

packageId.description: The package deployed, when several components shipped as one unit.

environmentId.description: The environment being reached. Must be active.

artifactId.description:
The build that actually shipped — 4.8.2.008 where the version number is 4.8.2. Two builds of
one version are two deployments. Free text, never parsed.

startedAt.description: When it began. Defaults to now, so a pipeline reporting in real time can omit it.

StartDeploymentRequest.description: Records that a version or package started reaching an environment.

completeOpenSprintId.description:
The team's open sprint, named to confirm completing it at the same moment. A team has one open sprint
at a time, so starting is refused while another is open unless this names it — and refused if it names
a sprint that is no longer the open one.

startedAt.description:
When the team started the sprint, now or earlier. Omit to record it as starting now. It must fall in
the sprint's start window, which the sprint details report.

name.description:
What the status was called when the record last moved. Frozen, so renaming a status does not
rewrite what past records read as.

category.description: The status's bucket — Proposed, Active, Done or Removed. What rollups and invariants group on.

alias.description:
The well-known meaning the status carries, as the consuming module's alias value, or
`0` when it carries none.

StatusNavigationDto.description: The status a record currently holds, as a reader needs it.

conditions.description:
What moving the record to this status needs, in kind order — `RequiresReason` means the move
must carry a reason. Empty when it needs nothing, and always empty when the options were asked for
without a record, since conditions belong to the move from the record's current status.

StatusOptionDto.description: A status a record can be moved to, with what the move needs.

fromStatusId.description: The status of the current workflow whose records are being moved.

toStatusId.description: The status of the target workflow those records should land on.

StatusRemapDecisionRequest.description: One operator decision: send this source status's records to that target status.

to.description: The status they would move to, or null when nothing could be chosen for them.

matchedBy.description: Why this row was matched — Alias, Name, Category, or Unresolved.

recordCount.description: How many records currently hold this status.

StatusRemapEntryDto.description: Where one status would send its records.

from.description: The workflow the scope is on now.

to.description: The workflow it would move to.

entries.description: One entry per status of the current workflow, in display order.

isComplete.description: Whether every status already has a target. The domain refuses an incomplete remap.

affectedRecordCount.description: How many records the reassignment would move.

StatusRemapPreviewDto.description: How each status of the current workflow would land in the target, before anything is committed.

sequence.description: Orders the history as it actually happened.

fromStatus.description: The status moved out of, or `null` when the record entered its initial status.

workflowId.description: The workflow that governed this change.

actorKind.description: The mechanism that made the change — a user, an import, a sync, the platform.

changedBy.description: The person who made the change, or `null` when none can be named.

changedByUser.description: The account behind the change, where there was one.

changedBySystem.description: Whether the platform made the change on its own behalf.

reason.description: Why the change was made, where a reason was recorded.

StatusTransitionDto.description: One status change from a record's history, as a reader needs it.

transitionMode.description: Whether records may move between any two statuses, or only along IReadOnlyCollection<WorkflowTransitionDto> StatusWorkflowDetailsDto.Transitions.

transitions.description:
The moves this workflow allows, ordered by their from and then their to status's position.
Enforced only when TransitionMode StatusWorkflowDetailsDto.TransitionMode is restricted.

availableConditions.description:
The conditions a transition other than a declared move may carry: those a record checks
itself, and those something is in place to evaluate. None when the owner type declares its moves,
since no method makes such a transition. Attaching any other is refused.

declaredMoves.description:
The moves this owner type's actions make, located in this workflow, in the order of their
statuses. Empty when the owner type moves to any status it is given.

supportsRestrictedTransitions.description:
Whether this workflow's owner type can be restricted to its transitions. A restricted workflow for
an owner type that cannot is refused at publish.

transitionIssues.description:
Why the transitions stop this workflow being published, one sentence per problem, each naming
the status at fault. Empty when the workflow allows any move.

missingRequiredAliases.description: The required aliases this workflow does not yet carry, named rather than numbered.

conditions.description: What a record needs before making this move, in kind order. Empty when it needs nothing.

WorkflowTransitionDto.description: A move a workflow allows, from one of its statuses to another.

fromStatusId.description: The status a record moves out of.

toStatusId.description: The status a record moves into.

conditions.description:
What a record needs before making the move, at most one of each kind. A move listed with none,
or without this field, loses any it had. Only the workflow's available conditions can be added.

WorkflowTransitionRequest.description: One move a workflow allows, between two of its statuses.

effort.description: The level-of-effort estimate, Scrum's backlog item estimate; null when unestimated.

size.description: The size estimate, the CMMI process's requirement estimate; null when unestimated.

effort.description: The level-of-effort estimate, often set on features and epics for longer-term planning; null when unestimated.

size.description: The size estimate, the CMMI process's requirement estimate; null when unestimated.

outcome.description:
Whether a forecast could be made: Forecast, Done, Not Enough History, Blocked by Dependency,
Cannot Forecast or Nothing Remaining. Only Forecast fills the percentiles and histogram.

forecastStart.description: The first simulated day (UTC): a trial that finishes on its first day finishes on this date.

lookbackDays.description: Days of history the teams' throughput was sampled from.

ignoreDependencies.description: Whether the forecast ignored dependencies, as a what-if.

startedWorkFirst.description: Whether active backlog items were counted ahead of proposed ones.

backlogPosition.description:
The 1-based position in its team's backlog, when the forecast is for a single open backlog
work item.

remainingWorkItems.description:
The open backlog work items the forecast is for. A backlog work item counts itself; a
portfolio work item counts its open backlog descendants.

excludedWorkItems.description:
Remaining work items left out because they could not be forecast (see `issues`
for why). A forecast with exclusions is a lower bound.

teams.description: Every team whose throughput the forecast drew on, including predecessors' teams.

targetDate.description:
The date the work is due, when there is one: an objective's target date or its planning
interval's end, or a project's planned end.

chanceOfFinishingByTargetDate.description:
The share of trials (0 to 1) that finished on or before `targetDate`. Null
without a target date or a forecast.

ignoredDependencies.description:
Dependencies left out of the forecast, each with its `reason`:
it closed a cycle, or its predecessor was removed.

issues.description: Why the work item, or something it depends on, could not be forecast or is only a lower bound.

effort.description: The level-of-effort estimate, Scrum's backlog item estimate; null when unestimated.

size.description: The size estimate, the CMMI process's requirement estimate; null when unestimated.

WorkItemProgressRollupDto.description: Progress data for a collection of work items.  Work items with a status category of Proposed, Active, and Done are counted.  Work items with a status category of Removed are not included

name.description: The name of the work status. It cannot be changed.

description.description: The description of the work status; null when it has none.

isActive.description: Whether the work status is active.

name.description: The name of the work type.

description.description: The description of the work type.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the work type is active.

name.description: The name of the work type level.

description.description: The description of the work type level; null when it has none.

tier.description: The tier the level belongs to: Portfolio, Requirement, Task or Other.

order.description: The level's position within its tier; levels sort by it in ascending order.

name.description: The name of the work type.
